description: This Java class implements a logging facade for Logback, providing methods to set log levels and retrieve logger configurations within a larger Java project. It interacts with Logback's Logger objects and integrates with the Eclipse Ditto framework's logging model.

classes.name: LogbackLoggingFacade
classes.description: A final class that implements the LoggingFacade interface for Logback, providing methods to configure and retrieve logger information.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of LogbackLoggingFacade.

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the log level for a specified logger based on provided LoggerConfig.

methods.name: getLoggerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves the logger configurations for all loggers.

methods.name: getLoggerConfig
methods.description: Retrieves logger configurations for a given iterable of logger names.
